content.title: Knicks vs. Pacers: Prediction, How to Watch for Free (3/13/26)
content.text: The New York Knicks (42–25) face the Indiana Pacers (15–50) tonight at Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis. New York enters after a 134–117 road win over the Utah Jazz, snapping a two-game losing streak. The Jazz led 41–26 at the end of the first quarter, and it initially looked like the Knicks were headed for one of those inexplicable losses where nothing seemed to click. But they regrouped in the second quarter and pulled away in the second half, using a decisive 20–4 run to take control. Jordan Clarkson was the catalyst off the bench, scoring 27 points as one of four Knicks players to reach the 20-point mark against Utah’s league-worst defense. Rookie Mohamed Diawara also delivered another strong performance, scoring 10 points in 15 minutes. Indiana, meanwhile, enters on an 11-game losing streak after falling 123–108 to the Phoenix Suns in its last outing. With Pascal Siakam sidelined, Andrew Nembhard led the Pacers with 23 points in just 17 minutes but did not return after halftime as Indiana faces allegations of tanking. These two teams have split their two previous meetings, both tight games decided by three points or less. Indiana seems to step up its game against New York, but doesn’t appear to be playing to win, dropping matchups against other struggling teams. Expect a double-digit Knicks win tonight. Prediction: New York Knicks 121, Indiana Pacers 109 Injury Report New York Knicks Josh Hart — GTD (Knee) Jeremy Sochan — GTD (Illness) Karl-Anthony Towns — GTD (Knee) Miles McBride — Out (Core muscle) Indiana Pacers Quenton Jackson — GTD (Calf) Andrew Nembhard — GTD (Back / Neck) T.J.
